title: BDO announces global agreement with Legora, bringing AI-powered transformation to legal services
summary: Legora is the collaborative AI powering lawyers to review and research faster, draft smarter, and advise with precision. Legora adapts to your ways of working, unlocking team and machine collaboration at scale.
body_markdown:
BDO, the leading international professional services provider, today announces a global agreement with Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals.


The global agreement provides BDO member firms with a common framework to adopt Legora, beginning with a coordinated rollout across its legal practices. It supports BDO’s wider strategy of responsible AI enablement and transforming how legal work is delivered across its global network.


Following an initial pilot earlier this year, a growing number of member firms are now using Legora, with further firms able to join the programme in the future. This initiative reflects BDO’s broader commitment to innovation and technology-enabled service delivery, helping legal professionals focus on strategic client advice, while maintaining the highest standards of professional judgement, quality and trust.


“The early experience and leadership of our legal practices in Spain and Norway helped us understand the potential of the platform and paved the way for the wider global initiative,” **said Caroline Macdonald, Director of Legal Services Coordination at BDO Global** . **** “By giving our professionals access to a leading legal AI platform and through a coordinated global approach, we can accelerate adoption, share experience across borders and support greater consistency in how we use AI, whilst preserving the professional relationships and local expertise that our clients rely on. Our goal is to equip our people with the skills and tools to respond to increasingly complex client needs, deliver greater value and continue evolving our services.”


Legora supports legal professionals with research, document review, drafting, summarisation and contract analysis across complex matters. Built alongside lawyers, the platform works within a firm’s own context, with permissions, ethical walls and an audit trail, so every output can be traced back to its source.


“BDO’s lawyers started using Legora because it fits the way they work, and interest is continuing to grow across the global network. The agreement is open to every BDO member firm, and as more of BDO’s professionals see what their colleagues are doing with Legora, we expect them to want the same,” **Patrick Forquer, CRO at Legora** .


The agreement builds on BDO’s strategy to strengthen capabilities and develop solutions for clients through the responsible use of AI. It forms part of BDO’s plans to accelerate technology adoption, promote greater collaboration across its global network and continue evolving how services are delivered to its clients.


BDO’s member firms join more than 2,500 law firms and in-house legal teams using Legora across over 80 markets.


**ENDS**


**About BDO**
The BDO network (referred to as the ‘BDO network’) is an international network of independent public accounting, tax and advisory firms which are members of BDO International Limited and perform professional services under the name and style of BDO (hereafter: ‘BDO member firms’). BDO International Limited is a UK company limited by guarantee. It is the governing entity of the BDO network.


Service provision within the BDO network is coordinated by Brussels Worldwide Services BV, a limited liability company incorporated in Belgium.


Each of BDO International Limited, Brussels Worldwide Services BV and the BDO member firms is a separate legal entity and has no liability for another entity’s acts or omissions. Nothing in the arrangements or rules of the BDO network shall constitute or imply an agency relationship or a partnership between BDO International Limited, Brussels Worldwide Services BV and/or the BDO member firms. Neither BDO International Limited nor any other central entities of the BDO network provide services to clients.


BDO is the brand name for the BDO network and for each of the BDO member firms.


The fee income of the BDO network was US$10.8 billion (€9.7 billion) in 2025. Member firms provide public accounting, tax and advisory services across 170 countries and territories, with over 94,900 people and 870 offices worldwide.


© Brussels Worldwide Services BV November 2026


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.
